content: Ekkema cha Juda
Iwa ekkema ch'efonamma cha Juda, atzori ka nnọmma sẹ etzim epyiri k'ẹkhọma ch'Edom maa, etza epyiri k'ibe s'anọng an-arukhi ka Zin k'okpong kw'okhubha kw'ẹrakha-ẹrakha.
Enem chabẹ k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha ẹttẹwọr m'ẹraangakha ch'Ọraanga kw'ideden kw'Onung,
epyiri k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha kw'Eden ch'Ininaang, etzima echina ka Zin, ẹkwọbha echina k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha kwa Kadẹsh-Barnea. Ejekha Hẹzrọn echina k'Adar, yina ẹn-ẹkhọri echina ka Karka.
Yina ẹn-ẹkwọbh echina Azmon ẹtza ẹjaakhi k'Ittolim s'Ijip, yina ẹn-ẹtza ekponga k'Ọraanga kw'ideden kwa Mediteraniya. Ma wọ ode enem chabẹ k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha.

K'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin, enem ewobha m'Ọraanga kw'ideden kw'Onung etzima epyiri kẹ da ọraanga kwa Jọrdan ọjaakhi k'ọraanga kw'ideden. Enem nda k'ebira-ebira ẹttẹwọr m'ibhakhi s'ọraanga kw'ideden kẹ da ọraanga kwa Jọrdan ọjaakhi k'ọraanga kw'ideden,
etzima epyiri ka Bẹt-Hogla, etzima epyiri k'ebira-ebira kwa Bẹt-Araba maa, epyiri k'Ọtza kwa Bohan. Wa Bohan ode nnwa kwa Reubẹn.

Enem nda en-evura echina ka Debir, ẹttẹwọr k'Ittolim s'Achọr, ẹtza ẹbhakhi echina k'ebira-ebira da achin ka Gilgal kw'okkeri Eden ch'Adumim itzitzikha, k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha kw'ittolim. Echina ororo maa, epyiri ka ngekha s'Ẹn-Shẹmẹsh ẹtza eyin k'Ẹn-Rogẹl.

En-erenga evura k'Ittolim sa Bẹn-Hinom echina k'ittolim ẹrakha-ẹrakha kw'odedenmon kw'anọng pa Jẹbus (kw'ode Jẹrusalẹm). Ttẹwọr mẹ en-evura echina k'egbegbeho k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'Ittolim sa Hinom k'okpong kw'okhubha kw'ebira-ebira kw'Ittolim sa Rephayim.
Ttẹwọr k'egbegbeho ebira, enem nda en-echina k'okhubha kw'okhekhaho kwa ngekha sa Nẹphtoa, eyin m'ibhon s'egbegbeho ch'Ẹphrọn, ẹn-ẹhakha echina Bala (kw'ode Kiriyat-Jẹarim).

Ẹn-ẹbhakhi echina k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi, ka Bala echina k'egbegbeho cha Seir, erenga k'ebira-ebira kw'Ittolim ka Jẹarim (kw'ode Kẹsalọn), echina ororo maa, ẹtza ẹhakha ka Bẹt-Shẹmẹsh, ejekha echina Timna.
Erenga echina k'ebira-ebira kw'Ittolim s'Ẹkrọn, ẹbhakhi echina Shikerọn, erenga ẹkwọbha egbegbeho cha Bala epyiri ka Jabnel. Enem nda ekponga k'ọraanga kw'ideden.
Ọraanga kw'ideden kwa Mediteraneya wọ ode enem k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi.
Ma wọ ode nnem sa ngọri anọng pa Juda, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.

Iwa Joshua ọnangi Kalẹb kw'ode nnwa kwa Jẹphunẹ, Kirayat Arba kw'ode Hẹbrọn mach'ekkema chẹ k'ẹkhọma cha Juda, otzor k'odem kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹ ọtzọhna bi osi. (Wa Arba wọ ode otte kw'ideden kw'anọng p'Anak.)
Wa Kalẹb okhubh va p'Anak, p'ade Shẹshayi ọmaana Ahiman ttara Talmayi ka Hẹbrọn.
Wa obina mẹ ọtza orima anọng pa Debir abẹ (Debir kw'iwa bẹ ayeri Kiriyat-Sẹphẹr).
Mẹ wọ ofon, wa Kalẹb oben bi, “Ojinọng kw'orim Kiriyat-Sẹpher abẹ obiro okhem-ẹ, kaam ńnang-ẹ Aksa, kw'ode nnwa kwaam kw'ikwanọng, k'ọbada.”
Wa Otniyẹl kw'ode nnwa kwa Kenaz, kw'ode ọgbaanotte kwa Kalẹb, okhema obhon nwa; mẹ wọ osi, wa Kalẹb ọnang-ẹ nnwa kwẹ kw'ikwanọng kw'okpen Aksa k'ọbada.
Iwa ewu dani, mada kwanọng nwa ofon kẹ okwu okhebha Otniyẹl, kwanọng nwa oben-ẹ bi, ophyem otte irerek. Mada ọhak k'ẹnyanyaang chẹ, Kalẹb ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Mbọng f'aror bi, ira nsi nnang-ọ?”
Kwanọng nwa obhina bi, “Kọhkh-m ọphyaam bi gbengene. Mada akk'aam irerek ananga ka Nẹgẹv, biri nang-m akhekhaho pa ngekha.” Wa Kalẹb ọnang-ẹ akhekhaho p'ebira-ebira ọmaana p'ẹrakha-ẹrakha.
Ma wọ ode ekkema ch'ẹkhọma cha Juda atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ:
Iwa ibhon s'iwobh k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha kwa Juda ka Nẹgẹv, da akkeri k'okhubha kw'enem ch'Edom ide: Kabzel, ọmaana Eder, ọmaana Jagur,
ọmaana Kina, ọmaana Dimona, ọmaana Adada,
ọmaana Kedẹsh, ọmaana Hazọr, ọmaana Itnan,
ọmaana Ziph, ọmaana Telem, ọmaana Bealot,
ọmaana Hazọr-Hadata, ọmaana Keriot-Hẹzrọn (kw'ode Hazọr),
ọmaana Amam, ọmaana Shema, ọmaana Molada,
ọmaana Hazar-Gada, ọmaana Heshmon, ọmaana Bẹt-Pẹlẹt,
ọmaana Hazar-Shual, ọmaana Beershẹba, ọmaana Biziotiya,
ọmaana Bala, ọmaana Iyim, ọmaana Ezem,
ọmaana Eltolad, ọmaana Kesil, ọmaana Horma,
ọmaana Ziklag, ọmaana Madmana, ọmaana Sansana,
ọmaana Lebayot, ọmaana Shilhim, ọmaana Ayin ttara Rimọn. Biphyir-phyir wa ode idedenmon ẹrọbh obhiri ọhawani, ọmaana abhonbhona pabẹ.
K'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho sa ndẹri-ọtzẹri, kẹ da ewuchen em-edimi, wa ode: Ẹshtaol, ọmaana Zora, ọmaana Ashna,
ọmaana Zanoa, ọmaana Ẹn-Ganim, ọmaana Tapua, ọmaana Enam,
ọmaana Jarmut, ọmaana Adulam, ọmaana Soko, ọmaana Azeka,
ọmaana Sharayim, ọmaana Aditayim ttara Gedera (kw'ode Gederotayim), kw'osi idedenmon ọhawani kwa chi ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa obiro ode ibhon sa Zenan, ọmaana Hadasha, ọmaana Migdal-Gad,
ọmaana Dilean, ọmaana Mizpa, ọmaana Joktẹl,
ọmaana Lakish, ọmaana Bozkat, ọmaana Ẹglọn,
ọmaana Kabon, ọmaana Lahmas, ọmaana Kitlish,
ọmaana Gederọt, ọmaana Bẹt-Dagọn, ọmaana Nama ttara Makeda, kw'osi idedenmon chi obhiri wani ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa obiro ode ibhon sa Libna, ọmaana Eter, ọmaana Ashan,
ọmaana Iphta, ọmaana Ashna, ọmaana Nezib,
ọmaana Keila, ọmaana Akzib ttara Maresha, kw'osi idedenmon ọhawani ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Ẹkrọn, ọmaana ibhon s'irukhi ikhọr-ẹ ttara abhobhona pabẹ;
k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'Ẹkrọn, ọmaana ibhon biphyir s'iwobh k'okhubha kw'Ashọd, ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ;
Ashọd ọmaana ibhon s'ikhọr-ẹ ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ maa, apyiri k'Ittolim s'Ijip ttara k'okhubha kw'Ọraanga kw'ideden kwa Mediteraniya.
K'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho ode: Shamir, ọmaana Jatir, ọmaana Soko,
ọmaana Dana, ọmaana Kiriyat-Sana (kw'ode Debir),
ọmaana Anab, ọmaana Eshtemọ, ọmaana Anim,
ọmaana Goshen, ọmaana Holon ttara Gilo, kw'osi idedenmon jobh obhiri wani ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa obiro ode ibhon s'Arab, ọmaana Duma, ọmaana Eshan,
ọmaana Janim, ọmaana Bẹt-Tapua, ọmaana Apheka,
ọmaana Humta, ọmaana Kiriyat-Arba (kw'ode Hẹbrọn) ttara Zior, kw'osi idedenmon ọhawani ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa obiro ode ibhon sa Maon, ọmaana Karmẹl, ọmaana Ziph, ọmaana Juta,
ọmaana Jezrel, ọmaana Jokdeam, ọmaana Zanoa,
ọmaana Kain, ọmaana Gibea ttara Timna, kw'osi idedenmon jobh ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa obiro ode ibhon sa Halhul, ọmaana Bẹt-Zur, ọmaana Gedor,
ọmaana Maarat, ọmaana Bẹt-Anot ttara Eltekon, kw'osi idedenmon izadani ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa obiro ode ibhon sa Kiriyat-Baal (kw'ode Kiriyat-Jearim) ọmaana Raba kw'ode idedenmon ifa ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
K'ibe s'iwa anọng an-arukhi ode: Bẹt-Araba, ọmaana Midin, ọmaana Sekaka,
ọmaana Nibshan, ọmaana odedenmon kw'Onung ọmaana Ẹn-Gẹdi kw'osi idedenmon izadani ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Wa anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Juda bẹ anọng pa Jẹbus p'arukhi ka Jẹrusalẹm kafha akhubh; anọng mba pa Jẹbus atzima arukhi ttara anọng pa Juda maa, apyiri k'ewu cha mayina.
